results.question: How long does Aurora store idempotency keys?
results.answer: Aurora stores idempotency keys for 24 hours [1].

queries: How long does Aurora store idempotency keys?

citations.text: POST requests that create charges accept an `Idempotency-Key` header. Aurora stores idempotency keys for 24 hours. Replaying a request with the same key within that window returns the original response without creating a second charge. Keys longer than 255 characters are rejected with error code `invalid_idempotency_key`.

citations.text:
Vantora Systems — Q3 2026 Financial Report
Summary
Vantora Systems closed Q3 2026 with total revenue of $48.2 million, a 14% increase over Q3 2025 ($42.3 million). Gross margin was 71.5%. Operating income was $6.9 million, compared with $4.1 million in the prior-year quarter. The company ended the quarter with $112 million in cash and no outstanding debt. Revenue by segment
Aurora Payments was the fastest-growing segment and now accounts for 57% of total revenue. Orion Hardware growth was held back by supply constraints on the Orion Pulse smartwatch, which was out of stock for three weeks in August. Headcount
Vantora ended the quarter with 612 employees, up from 571 at the end of Q2. Engineering accounts for 287 of those employees. The company opened a new office in Toronto in September with 18 initial hires. Customer metrics
Aurora processed $9.4 billion in total payment volume during the quarter. The number of active Aurora merchants reached 31,400. Net revenue retention for Aurora was 118%. Orion Hardware shipped 212,000 devices, of which the Orion Pulse accounted for 74,000. Outlook
Management expects Q4 2026 revenue between $51 million and $53 million. Full-year 2026 revenue is guided to $190 million to $194 million. Capital expenditures for the full year are expected to be approximately $11 million, primarily for the new Toronto office and data center expansion. The company does not plan to pay a dividend in 2026.

citations.text:
Incident Postmortem: Kestrel Database Failover
(INC-2291)
Date of incident: September 14, 2026. Severity: SEV-1. Author: Priya Raman, Site Reliability
Engineering. Summary
On September 14, 2026, the primary Aurora Payments database cluster, internally named Kestrel,
failed to fail over automatically after the primary node lost network connectivity. Charge creation was
unavailable for 47 minutes. No data was lost. Approximately 3,900 merchants experienced failed
charges during the window. Timeline
All times are UTC. (cid:127) 14:02 — Monitoring detects elevated error rates on the charge creation endpoint. (cid:127) 14:05 — The on-call engineer, Tomas Weber, is paged and acknowledges within two minutes. (cid:127) 14:11 — The incident is declared SEV-1 and an incident channel is opened. (cid:127) 14:24 — The team determines that the automatic failover did not trigger because the health check
required three consecutive failures from two witness nodes, and one witness node was itself
partitioned. (cid:127) 14:41 — Manual promotion of the replica in availability zone B is initiated. (cid:127) 14:49 — The replica is promoted and charge creation recovers. (cid:127) 15:20 — The incident is closed after monitoring confirms stable error rates. Root cause
The failover quorum configuration assumed three witness nodes were always reachable. A network
partition isolated one witness along with the primary, so the quorum could not be reached. The
configuration had not been reviewed since the cluster was provisioned in 2024. Impact
Charge creation was down for 47 minutes, from 14:02 to 14:49 UTC. Webhook deliveries were delayed
but not lost; all queued webhooks were delivered by 15:35. The customer support team received 212
tickets related to the incident. Action items

Summary
Vantora Systems closed Q3 2026 with total revenue of $48.2 million, a 14% increase over Q3 2025 ($42.3 million). Gross margin was 71.5%.
